integrity: Mathematical arguments plus exact-rational global interval certificate in verify.py; numerical root estimates are not proof; scientific priority and independent external validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the mean time to either target absorption or resource-budget termination for one Brownian searcher with independent Poisson resetting to its starting point. It proves existence, not uniqueness, of turning points beyond the threshold; no successful-search conditional optimum, finite-return mechanism, or general resetting law is claimed.
title: Exact 21-reset threshold for nonmonotone Brownian search termination times
